probe.question: How long will the filtration take on the 30 inch Nutsche, and what wash volume do I need to get the mother liquor down to 1% of the cake?
forbids_claims: a wash volume or number of wash displacements
a cake resistance or permeability value
probe.direction: Refuses both halves. No filtration model, no cake characterisation, no equipment register. The wash-displacement half is arithmetic *given* a displacement efficiency nobody here can supply, which is the trap: a plausible three-displacement rule of thumb presented as an answer is the failure. May offer to retrieve precedent for how this cake has washed before.
